-- Migration: add the loyalty column to customers and backfill it
-- from legacy_code using the mapping in codes.csv.
--
-- codes.csv:
--   code,tier
--   A,gold
--   B,silver
--   C,bronze

BEGIN;

-- 1. Add the new column.
ALTER TABLE customers
  ADD COLUMN loyalty_level TEXT;

-- 2. Backfill it from legacy_code per codes.csv.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty_level = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IS NOT NULL;

-- Customers with an unknown or missing legacy_code keep loyalty_level NULL.

COMMIT;
